title: Vulkanium
description: A Vulkan-powered Minecraft performance / optimization pack replacing OpenGL with Vulkan for higher FPS and smoother gameplay.
body:
# Important

If your game is crashing with error `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Out of stack space.` add this to your java arguments `-Dorg.lwjgl.system.stackSize=256`

# 📌 About the Modpack

This modpack is designed to enhance Minecraft’s performance and visuals without changing the core gameplay experience. It focuses on optimization, smooth performance, and compatibility with many OptiFine-like features - all while keeping your game feeling vanilla.

# ✨ Features

- ⚡ Vulkan-based rendering
- 📈 Higher FPS and smoother frame times
- 🎮 OptiFine-style features without using OptiFine
- 🔗 Connected textures support
- 🔍 Zoom functionality
- ☁️ Enhanced visual compatibility
- 🖥️ Works on a wide range of hardware
- 🌿 Keeps the vanilla Minecraft experience

## 📊 Performance Benchmarks

Tested on:
- **CPU:** Intel Core i5-14600K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA RTX 3070
- **Resolution:** 2560×1441
- **RAM Allocation:** 4GB
- **Render Distance:** 8 chunks
- **Simulation Distance:** 8 chunks

Results:

| Configuration                   | FPS |
| ------------------------------- | -----------: |
| 🚀 Vulkanium                    | **1700 FPS** |
| ⚡ Fabulously Optimized (Sodium) | **1266 FPS** |
| 🌿 Vanilla Minecraft            | **1042 FPS** |

These results demonstrate Vulkanium's performance improvements compared to traditional OpenGL-based rendering and other optimization setups. Actual performance may vary depending on hardware, drivers, Minecraft version, and system configuration.

# 💡 Who is this for?

Vulkanium is made for players who:
- Want better performance without changing Minecraft gameplay
- Need an alternative to OptiFine or Sodium
- Want smoother gameplay on modern GPUs
- Prefer a lightweight optimization setup
